name: Invalid wildcard Principal ARN on a resource policy surfaces fail-closed
note: IAM-1208 (Phase 12.1, fix 4): an AWS Principal ARN carrying a partial '*'/'?' wildcard (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/app/*) is an INVALID Principal element - AWS rejects such a policy at save time and the granted set is UNDETERMINED. It is neither a specific same/cross-account grant nor a broad one, so the named-principal branches never emit it and, before this fix, it was silently dropped (zero findings). The evaluator now fails closed toward surfacing with one RESOURCE-UNSUPPORTED-PRINCIPAL finding (high), never expanding the wildcard into 'every matching role' and never dropping it. No graph can-access edge is drawn (the reach is UNDETERMINED). Must not be mis-analyzed as identity.

RESOURCE-UNSUPPORTED-PRINCIPAL: NOT a valid IAM Principal element
